issues: Missing canon editorial verb 'Refine Material Narrative' — spec lists 4 verbs (Compose / Adapt / Refine / Publish), 3 are wired. Recommend renaming the material_language block heading or save-CTA to 'Refine Material Narrative' so the canon vocabulary is complete.

fixed_during_testing.issue: Endpoint POST /api/portfolio/admin/projects/{id}/compose returned 500 (instead of 200 on success or 502 on composer failure). RCA: `chat.with_max_tokens(2400)` raised AttributeError — emergentintegrations.LlmChat exposes `with_model()`, `with_params(**)` but no `with_max_tokens`. Exception was not caught by composer's try/except (it wrapped only `chat.send_message`), so it bubbled up as 500.
fixed_during_testing.fix: Replaced `.with_max_tokens(2400)` with `.with_params(max_tokens=2400)`. REAL Claude compose then succeeded in ~21s for the demo tenant's Italian market, persisted a culturally-adapted variant (target_locale=it-IT, cultural_angle/hospitality_tone/material_language/story_body all non-empty, not a literal translation).

Any chat-API drift will turn into a hard 500 rather than the documented 502 ok:false contract. Move the chat-init into the try block.

Consider a top-level try/except in the endpoint that converts unexpected exceptions into 502 with the same shape.

ProjectsStudioPage.jsx editor uses inline `setSelected({...selected, ...r.data})` on save — same dirty-flag pattern flagged in iteration_58 for StorefrontStudioPage. Same recommendation: keep dirty=true on PATCH failure so user sees their unsaved edits.

router.py uses `body.model_dump(exclude_none=True)` on PATCH — clients cannot intentionally null a field. Acceptable for v1; document or add explicit `set_null` flag if needed later.
Sidebar nav uses fallback='Projects Studio' but I18n key 'nav.projectsStudio' — ensure the key is added to the it/en/de/fr/es dictionaries to avoid mixed-locale chrome for tenant_admins.

rca_of_the_issue: Compose 500 bug RCA: emergentintegrations.LlmChat does NOT expose `with_max_tokens(n)` — only `with_model(provider, model)` and `with_params(**kwargs)`. The composer was calling `chat.with_model(*DEFAULT_MODEL).with_max_tokens(2400)` which raised AttributeError BEFORE the try/except that wraps `chat.send_message`. FastAPI bubbled it to a generic 500. Reproduction: POST /api/portfolio/admin/projects/{id}/compose with any valid market_id → 500 Internal Server Error in <1s (no LLM call ever fired). Backend log: `AttributeError: 'LlmChat' object has no attribute 'with_max_tokens'` at project_market_composer.py:194. Fix: one-line change `.with_max_tokens(2400)` → `.with_params(max_tokens=2400)`. Post-fix verified: real Claude returned a culturally-adapted Italian variant in 21s, status 200 + ok:true + variant_id.
